name: Chicken Clucking for a Mint
summary: At Hallow's End, Innkeeper Norman of the Undercity offers a sweet to travelers helping an ailing child. Earn the Undercity Mint by setting dignity aside and flapping like a chicken.

sections.title: A Rare Bit of Mirth
sections.body: Laughter is scarce in the Undercity, built beneath Lordaeron's ruins by the liberated Forsaken. Yet when Hallow's End comes, even the grim folk of the Trade Quarter join the revelry. Innkeeper Norman keeps Undercity Mints for travelers gathering treats for Spoops, a sick orphan who needs holiday cheer.

sections.title: Earning the Treat
sections.body: Innkeeper Norman will not hand a treat to seasoned adventurers without a show. He believes grown warriors and spellcasters should earn their sweets. So the petitioner must mimic a barnyard chicken right before his counter.

faq.q: Why does Innkeeper Norman want me to cluck like a chicken?
faq.answer: Innkeeper Norman thinks grown champions should put on a show before they go trick-or-treating. To lift the Hallow's End mood, he asks you to flap and cluck like a chicken before handing over the treat.

faq.q: Who is the treat intended for?
faq.answer: The Undercity Mint is for Spoops, a sick orphan resting in Orgrimmar who cannot go trick-or-treating during Hallow's End.
Innkeeper Norman keeps the central tavern in the Undercity's Trade Quarter, serving Forsaken patrons and visiting Horde travelers.

faq.q: Is this a seasonal festival quest?
faq.answer: Yes. It is part of Hallow's End, the annual holiday celebrated across Azeroth by both Horde and Alliance.

faq.q: Do Forsaken normally celebrate Hallow's End?
faq.answer: The Forsaken celebrate Hallow's End with great enthusiasm. They burn a massive wicker man outside Lordaeron's ruins to honor their liberation and break with their former mortal lives.

faq.q: What happens after getting the Undercity Mint?
aliases: what do i do with the mint
faq.answer: The Undercity Mint joins signature treats gathered from the Horde's racial capitals to make a full holiday gift for young Spoops.

angles.text: Laughter in the Undercity's rotting halls is rare. Norman's seasonal demand brings a strange break from daily necromantic pragmatism.
During Hallow's End, Horde travelers visit every capital city and endure foolish indignities to bring joy to an orphaned child.
